Flux.1 开发人员雇用修复工作流程是专门为Flux.1 开发者模型。我建议使用Flux.1 fp8版本模型的。该模型通过逆向工程提示单词unsloth-Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-指示并使用增强细节最终器，因此您无需输入任何提示文字即可有效运行此工作流程。

一、参数

1.去噪级别：降噪幅度应在 0.4 至 0.6 左右。如果您要更改样式，则需要更高的降噪幅度。

2.ControlNet Upscaler 重量：将其设置在 0.8 至 1.0 之间。

3.放大倍数：不要超过 2 倍的放大倍数，因为它可能会引入许多伪影（例如网格图案）。如果您需要超过 2 倍，请分两步执行 HD 修复 - 使用第一个 HD 修复的结果作为第二个 HD 修复的输入。

2. 型号

您将需要以下三个模型：

1.法学硕士模式：这是大型语言模型集。首次运行时它将自动下载。如果下载失败，您可以手动下载并放入ComfyUI/models/LLM/unsloth--Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct文件夹中。

下载链接:https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

2.剪辑视觉：这是视觉任务的剪辑模型。下载所有文件并将其放置在 ComfyUI/models/clip_vision/google--siglip-so400m-patch14-384 文件夹中。

下载链接：https://huggingface.co/google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384/tree/main

3.乔伊字幕洛拉：这是字幕的 lora 模型。下载所有文件并将其放置在 ComfyUI/models/Joy_caption/cgrkzexw-599808 文件夹中。

下载链接: https://huggingface.co/spaces/fancyfeast/joy-caption-alpha-two

4.ControlNet HD 维修模型：下载此模型并将其重命名为Flux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler。将其放在 models/controlnet/flux 文件夹中。

下载链接: https://huggingface.co/jasperai/Flux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler/resolve/main/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors?download=true

o.en:
Flux.1 dev Hires Fix Workflowis a high-definition repair workflow specifically designed for theFlux.1 devmodel. I recommend using theFlux.1 fp8 versionof the model. This model reverse-engineers prompt words throughunsloth–Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instructand enhances details usingultimator, so you don’t need to input any prompt words to effectively run this workflow.

1. Parameters

1.Denoising Level: The denoising amplitude should be around 0.4 to 0.6. If you are changing the style, a higher denoising amplitude is required.

2.ControlNet Upscaler Weight: Set it between 0.8 to 1.0.

3.Magnification Factor: Do not exceed a magnification of 2x, as it may introduce many artifacts (such as grid patterns). If you need to go beyond 2x, perform the HD fix in two steps—use the result from the first HD fix as the input for the second.

2. Models

You will need the following three models:

1.LLM Model: This is the large language model set. It will automatically download on the first run. If the download fails, you can manually download it and place it in the ComfyUI/models/LLM/unsloth--Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct folder.

Download Link:https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

2.Clip Vision: This is the clip model for vision tasks. Download all files and place them in the ComfyUI/models/clip_vision/google--siglip-so400m-patch14-384 folder.

Download Link: https://huggingface.co/google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384/tree/main

3.Joy Caption Lora: This is the lora model for captioning. Download all files and place them in the ComfyUI/models/Joy_caption/cgrkzexw-599808 folder.

Download Link: https://huggingface.co/spaces/fancyfeast/joy-caption-alpha-two

4.ControlNet HD Repair Model: Download this model and rename it toFlux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler. Place it in the models/controlnet/flux folder.

Download Link: https://huggingface.co/jasperai/Flux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler/resolve/main/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors?download=true
